About this app

Daily Cost is a simple Android app for keeping track of what you spend every day. Note down your costs as they happen and keep your daily spending in one place.

It can send you reminder notifications, so logging your expenses becomes a habit and nothing slips through.

App permissions

What the app is allowed to do on your phone, as declared in the APK.

  • NotificationsShow reminder notifications.
  • Exact alarmsSend reminders at the exact time you choose.

How to install an APK

These apps are installed directly from this website instead of Google Play. It takes a minute:

  1. 01

    Download

    Tap Install above on your Android phone and let the download finish.

  2. 02

    Open the file

    Open it from your notifications or the Downloads folder.

  3. 03

    Allow the install

    If asked, allow your browser or Files app to install unknown apps (Settings → Apps → Special access).

  4. 04

    Install & open

    Tap Install, then Open. Google Play Protect may scan the app first.
